quotes: (4) Before admitting the first visitor, the organizer must give the agency either a signed paper inspection record or an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer.
claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0006 severely truncates the source requirement by omitting the alternative option ('an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer') in its summary, object, and alternatives representation (choice_text only lists 'a signed paper inspection record'). This incorrectly converts an 'either/or' choice into a strict mandate to provide a paper record.

unit_judgments.rationale: Claim C0006 only extracts one branch of the disjunctive requirement ('a signed paper inspection record') while completely dropping the alternative ('an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer'), thereby altering the legal obligation.
